audit.why: EVEN / 6/10 fits 48.56%. Restating the mirror (singed__gnar) from this side: neither champion can punish the other in lane, the flip is Singed's at 6 and first item, and it re-evens once Gnar becomes a teamfight tool rather than a duellist.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with the mirror, which was already fixed to Skill / Gnar / Skill / Gnar / Singed / Singed / Skill. Stored sides were Skill / Singed / Singed / Skill / Skill / Singed / Singed. Separately, whys[3] and whys[4] were shifted one slot: whys[3] (Levels 4-5) claimed a GNAR! wall-pin, which needs level 6, and whys[4] (Level 6) described his first-item Rylai's spike instead of Insanity Potion.
audit.why: The mirror is authoritative and must not be contradicted; the packet chart agrees with it. Spike content: Gnar level 2, Gnar Rage windows at 4-5, Singed's Insanity Potion at 6 (100s, and it applies Grievous Wounds), Singed's Rylai's first item, level-out late.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group across both layers; whys[3] limited to Mega Wallop, whys[4] rewritten to Insanity Potion, whys[5] rewritten to the Rylai's plus grounding spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) Singed's passive is described as 'heal-on-spend' in whys[0] and the early block — that is not his passive. Noxious Slipstream gives him a burst of Move Speed when passing champions; there is no heal. (b) Mega Adhesive grounds, and nothing on the page said so, even though a grounded Gnar cannot cast Hop (E) at all — which is the entire reason his Fling-into-goo kills you.
audit.why: The fabricated passive makes the reader plan around sustain that does not exist, and the missing grounding makes them believe Hop is always an escape. The mirror fixed exactly this from Singed's side, so the two pages would otherwise contradict.
audit.corrected: Noxious Slipstream is move speed on passing, not healing. Mega Adhesive (W, 17s at rank 1, 1000 range) slows and grounds — standing in it your Hop (22s at rank 1) will not cast. Fling (E, 10s at rank 1) roots as well if it lands you in the adhesive. Insanity Potion (R, 100s) applies Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail. Both sides carry displacement — GNAR! (90/60/30, Mega only) against Fling — and whoever lands it first owns the trade.

edits.before: Singed's heal-on-spend and move speed shrug off your Boomerang poke, but his sustain answers your range — neither of you can punish, so it is a wash.

edits.before: When Rage fills, a Mega Wallop into GNAR! pins him to a wall for the extra stun — the only reliable lockdown on a champ this slippery.

edits.before: His first Rylai's/Liandry's makes Poison Trail and the Insanity Potion run-down sticky enough to start beating your Boomerang kite.

edits.before: Once he is tanky your single Wallop stun can't lock him, so his Fling-into-poison and proxy sustain run you down in any sidelane duel.
edits.after: Rylai's makes Poison Trail sticky and Mega Adhesive grounds you — standing in the goo you cannot Hop out at all, so his run-down lands.

edits.before: Singed gives you nothing to poke down — his passive heal-on-spend and move speed shrug off Boomerang chip — so the early game is about tempo, not a kill. Level 1 is a wash: your ranged Mini autos out-range him but his sustain eats the chip. At Level 2, slam a Mini W (Hyper) third-hit proc plus a Boomerang into him before he has Poison Trail stacked or his Fling (E) ready — that is your one clean free trade. Never sit in his Poison Trail to line up a Boomerang, and respect that a Fling onto his poison in Mini form chunks your squishy frame hard.
edits.after: Singed gives you nothing to poke down — Noxious Slipstream hands him a move-speed burst every time he passes you, so Boomerang chip never sticks and the early game is about tempo, not a kill. Level 1 is a wash: your ranged Mini autos out-range him but he drifts away before you stack damage. At Level 2, slam a Mini W (Hyper) third-hit proc plus a Boomerang into him before he has Poison Trail stacked or his Fling (E, 10s) ready. Never line up a Boomerang from inside his Poison Trail, and never fight in Mega Adhesive: it grounds you, and a grounded Gnar cannot cast Hop.

edits.before: His flip. Mega-CC after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fling is 10s at rank 1 — into Mega Adhesive it roots you as well.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds — inside it Hop will not cast, and Fling roots.

notes: Real fabricated mechanic killed here: Singed's passive was described as 'heal-on-spend'. Noxious Slipstream is a move-speed burst on passing champions — there is no sustain in it, and the whole 'his sustain eats your chip' framing rested on that. The mirror's grounding finding is now stated from Gnar's side (grounded means Hop does not cast), so the two pages agree. Level chart aligned to the mirror's already-corrected order.
